title: Sone Ma A’Poi: The Witch Team (AIF)
content:
Indigenous Modernity, Myanmar’s Spring Revolution and the Fourth World War. New Zine from the WITCH team, the revolution’s all women’s drone team fighting in the hills of Myanmar.

This is a zine by Women Internationalists of the Chin Hills (WITCH) of Anti-Fascist Internationalist Front (AIF).

Reference: https://aifmyanmar.noblogs.org/post/2026/07/22/sone-ma-apoi-the-witch-team/
